overview.title: Ububiko
overview.description: Ibiri mu bubiko ubu, n'ibigiye kushira.
overview.loadFailed: Ntitwashoboye kubona ububiko. Reba uko interineti ihagaze hanyuma wongere ugerageze.

lowStock.title: Ububiko buke
lowStock.countDescription: Ibicuruzwa {{total}} mu rutonde rwose bigeze cyangwa biri hasi y'urugero ntarengwa rwashyizwe.
lowStock.noneDescription: Nta gicuruzwa kigeze cyangwa kiri hasi y'urugero ntarengwa rwacyo. Nta kintu gikenewe gutumizwa kubera ibi.
lowStock.caption: Ibicuruzwa bigeze cyangwa biri hasi y'urugero ntarengwa, hamwe n'ikigega kibifite, ibisigaye n'urugero ntarengwa.
lowStock.emptyBody: Ibicuruzwa byose bibarwa biri hejuru y'urugero ntarengwa rwabyo. Shyira urugero ntarengwa ku gicuruzwa kugira ngo uburirwe hano.

valuation.title: Agaciro k'ububiko
valuation.description: Ibicuruzwa byose bibarwa bikiri mu bubiko, bihawe agaciro k'ibyo koperative yabitangiye.
valuation.estimatedNote: Imibare {{total}} muri iyi ishingiye ku giciro cyateganyijwe aho kuba ku nyemezabwishyu, kuko nta kintu cyaguzwe ku giciro kizwi cyarakiriwe.
valuation.allCosted: Imibare yose iri hano ishingiye ku byo koperative yishyuye koko.

filters.lowOnlyHint: Ibicuruzwa bigeze cyangwa biri hasi y'urugero ntarengwa rwabyo.
filters.inStockOnlyHint: Bikuraho imirongo iri kuri zeru, ari myinshi mu rutonde rurerure.

stock.caption: Ibyo buri kigega kifite, hamwe n'igicuruzwa, ingano n'urugero ntarengwa rwashyizweho.
stock.emptyBody: Andika ibyo koperative yakiriye, hanyuma bigaragare hano n'ikigega kibifite.
stock.emptyFilteredBody: Hitamo ikindi kigega cyangwa ikindi cyiciro, cyangwa ukureho ibyatoranyijwe urebe ibyo koperative ifite byose.

movementFields.productPlaceholder: Shakisha ukoresheje izina cyangwa kode y'igicuruzwa
movementFields.quantityHint: Imibare gusa. Nibura imyanya itatu nyuma ya akadomo.
movementFields.quantityHintUnit: Mu {{unit}}. Imyanya itatu nyuma ya akadomo ku birenze, urugero 400.500.
movementFields.unitCost: Igiciro cya buri kimwe mu RWF
movementFields.unitCostHint: Sige ubusa iyo nta giciro cyemejwe, nk'uko bisanzwe ku byatanzwe n'umunyamuryango.
movementFields.occurredAtHint: Uyu munsi, keretse ibicuruzwa byimutse ku rundi munsi.
movementFields.memberHint: Sige ubusa keretse umunyamuryango umwe yabizanye. Kumuvuga bishyira ibyatanzwe ku rupapuro rwe.
movementFields.memberPlaceholder: Shakisha ukoresheje izina, kode y'umunyamuryango cyangwa nimero ya telefone
movementFields.noteHint: Umurongo umwe ibiro bizakumva n'umwaka utaha, urugero: itike y'igipimo 118.

receiveDialog.title: Kwakira ibicuruzwa mu kigega
receiveDialog.description: Ibicuruzwa bigeze kuri koperative. Ingano iri mu kigega yiyongera ako kanya nyuma y'iyandikwa.
receiveDialog.done: {{quantity}} bya {{product}} byakiriwe nka {{reference}}. Ikigega ubu kifite {{level}}.
receiveDialog.expenseIntro: Iyo koperative yishyuye igihe yakiraga, hitamo icyiciro cy'amafaranga asohoka kandi igiciro cyandikwa mu bitabo icyarimwe. Utabikoze, ibicuruzwa birinjira gusa.

receiveErrors.quantity: Andika ingano irenze zeru, ukoresheje imibare gusa, ifite imyanya itatu nyuma ya akadomo ku birenze.
receiveErrors.unitCost: Andika igiciro cya buri kimwe, ukoresheje imibare gusa, ifite imyanya ibiri nyuma ya akadomo ku birenze. Igiciro girasabwa kugira ngo amafaranga yasohotse yandikwe.
receiveErrors.expenseCategoryId: Hitamo icyiciro cy'amafaranga asohoka igiciro kigenda.

issueDialog.title: Gusohora ibicuruzwa mu kigega
issueDialog.description: Ibicuruzwa bisohoka kuri koperative ku mpamvu itari igurisha. Ingano iri mu kigega igabanuka ako kanya nyuma y'iyandikwa.
issueDialog.done: {{quantity}} bya {{product}} byasohowe nka {{reference}}. Ikigega ubu kifite {{level}}.
issueDialog.notEnoughNow: Twongeye kureba ingano: {{warehouse}} kifite {{level}}. Sohora ibyo cyangwa bike, cyangwa ubanze ukosore ibarura niba ikigega kifite byinshi koko.
issueDialog.notEnoughUnknown: Sohora bike kurusha ibyo wasabye, cyangwa ubanze ukosore ibarura niba ikigega kifite byinshi koko.

issueErrors.quantity: Andika ingano irenze zeru, ukoresheje imibare gusa, ifite imyanya itatu nyuma ya akadomo ku birenze.

adjustDialog.title: Gukosora ibarura
adjustDialog.description: Ni ku gihe ibarura ryakorewe mu kigega ritandukanye n'inyandiko. Andika ibyo wabaruye hanyuma igikosora kibarwe ku bwawe.
adjustDialog.countedHint: Ingano wasanze mu kigega, atari itandukaniro. Zeru ni ibarura nyakuri.
adjustDialog.countedHintUnit: Ingano wasanze, mu {{unit}} — atari itandukaniro. Zeru ni ibarura nyakuri.
adjustDialog.reasonHint: Umurongo umwe, urugero: imifuka ibiri yangijwe n'imvura ntiyandikwa.
adjustDialog.restate: Ibi byandika ko {{counted}} bya {{product}} byabaruwe mu kigega. Igikosora cyo hejuru cyangwa hasi kibarwa hashingiwe ku nyandiko.
adjustDialog.done: Ibarura rya {{product}} ryanditswe nka {{reference}}. Ikigega ubu kifite {{level}}.

adjustErrors.countedQuantity: Andika ibyo wabaruye, ukoresheje imibare gusa, ufite imyanya itatu nyuma ya akadomo ku birenze. Zeru yemewe.
adjustErrors.reason: Vuga impamvu inyandiko yari itari yo. Igikosora kidafite impamvu ntikibasha kusobanurwa nyuma.

transferDialog.title: Kwimura ibicuruzwa hagati y'ibigega
transferDialog.description: Ibicuruzwa bivuye mu kigega kimwe cya koperative bijya mu kindi. Handikwa ibikorwa bibiri, kimwe cyo gusohoka n'ikindi cyo kwinjira.
transferDialog.sameStore: Hitamo ikindi kigega. Kwimurira ibicuruzwa mu kigega bivuyemo ntibyimura kintu.
transferDialog.done: {{quantity}} bya {{product}} byimuwe. Byasohotse nka {{outReference}} kandi byinjiye nka {{inReference}}.

transferErrors.quantity: Andika ingano irenze zeru, ukoresheje imibare gusa, ifite imyanya itatu nyuma ya akadomo ku birenze.

movements.title: Amateka y'ibikorwa
movements.description: Ibikorwa byose by'ububiko koperative yanditse, biheruka bibanza.
movements.caption: Ibikorwa by'ububiko, hamwe n'inomero, itariki, ubwoko, igicuruzwa, ikigega n'ingano.
movements.loadFailed: Ntitwashoboye kubona amateka. Reba uko interineti ihagaze hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
movements.totalsCover: Iyi mibare ibiri ireba impapuro zose z'ibyatoranyijwe, iteranyijwe mu bipimo byose.
movements.emptyBody: Akira ibicuruzwa bya mbere mu kigega hanyuma bigaragare hano n'inomero yabyo.
movements.emptyFilteredBody: Agura amatariki, cyangwa ukureho ibyatoranyijwe urebe amateka yose.

reverse.title: Uremeza kwandika igikosora cy'iki gikorwa?
reverse.consequence: Igikorwa kiguma mu mateka, kandi iruhande rwacyo handikwe igikorwa kingana na cyo ku rundi ruhande, ku buryo ingano iri mu kigega isubira uko yari. Nta kintu gikurwaho.
reverse.transferWarning: Iki gikorwa ni uruhande rumwe rw'iryimuka hagati y'ibigega bibiri. Impande zombi zikosorwa icyarimwe, kuko gukosora rumwe gusa byasiga ibicuruzwa byanditse mu kigega bitageze.
reverse.reasonHint: Umurongo umwe, urugero: byanditswe kabiri mu makosa.
reverse.donePair: {{reference}} yakosowe ku mpande zombi z'iryimuka. Ibikosora ni {{first}} na {{second}}.

products.title: Ibicuruzwa
products.description: Ibyo koperative ikora. Igicuruzwa ntigisibwa, gihagarikwa gusa.
products.caption: Urutonde rw'ibicuruzwa, hamwe na kode, amazina yombi, icyiciro, igipimo, ibiri mu bubiko n'urugero ntarengwa.
products.loadFailed: Ntitwashoboye kubona urutonde rw'ibicuruzwa. Reba uko interineti ihagaze hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
products.retireConsequence: Igicuruzwa ntikizongera gutangwa igihe ibicuruzwa byakirwa, bisohorwa cyangwa bigurishwa, kandi ibikorwa byose byamaze kwandikwa kuri cyo biguma uko biri. Kishobora gusubizwaho igihe icyo ari cyo. Nta kintu gisibwa.
products.restoreConsequence: Kizongera gutangwa igihe ibicuruzwa byakirwa, bisohorwa cyangwa bigurishwa.
products.emptyBody: Ongeramo ibyo koperative ikora, hanyuma ububiko bushobore kwakirwa kuri byo.
products.emptyFilteredBody: Hitamo ikindi cyiciro cyangwa ubundi bwoko, cyangwa ukureho ibyatoranyijwe urebe urutonde rwose.

productDialog.addDescription: Ikintu koperative igura, ibika cyangwa igurisha. Igipimo uhisemo hano ni igipimo ingano zose zizandikwamo.
productDialog.editDescription: Kode n'amazina ahora ashobora guhinduka. Igipimo n'ibijyanye n'uko kibarwa ntibihinduka iyo ububiko bwamaze kwimuka.
productDialog.unitFrozen: Igipimo ntigishobora guhinduka: ububiko bwamaze kwimuka muri iki gipimo, kandi guhindura cyo byasubiramo ingano zose zamaze kwandikwa.
productDialog.countingFrozen: Ibijyanye n'uko iki gicuruzwa kibarwa ntibishobora guhinduka: ububiko bwamaze kwimuka, kandi guhagarika ibarura byasiga ingano yacyo nta gikorwa kivuga aho yagiye.
productDialog.typeFixed: Igicuruzwa kiguma ari ibicuruzwa cyangwa serivisi burundu.
productDialog.serviceNotCounted: Serivisi ntibikwa mu kigega, bityo ntibarwa na rimwe.

productFields.nameRwHint: Rigaragarira uwo wese usoma sisitemu mu Kinyarwanda. Sige ubusa ukoreshe izina riri hejuru.
productFields.skuHint: Iyo usize ubusa, kode ikorwa hashingiwe ku izina.
productFields.unitHint: Ingano zose z'iki gicuruzwa zandikwa muri iki gipimo, bityo gihitemo mbere y'ibyatanzwe bya mbere.
productFields.typeHint: Ibicuruzwa bibikwa mu kigega. Serivisi ntibikwa.
productFields.trackedHint: Bikoreshwe ku kintu cyose kibikwa mu kigega. Bihagarikwe ku kintu koperative itanga aho kubika.
productFields.minStockLevelHint: Urugero iki gicuruzwa kigaragarira nk'ikiri hafi kushira. Sige ubusa nta kumenyesha.
productFields.purchasePrice: Igiciro gisanzwe cyo kugura mu RWF

productFields.salePrice: Igiciro gisanzwe cyo kugurisha mu RWF

categories.title: Ibyiciro by'ibicuruzwa
categories.description: Uko urutonde rw'ibicuruzwa rucitsemo. Icyiciro ntigisibwa, gihagarikwa gusa.
categories.caption: Ibyiciro by'ibicuruzwa, hamwe n'izina ry'Ikinyarwanda, umubare w'ibicuruzwa biri muri buri cyiciro n'uko kihagaze.
categories.formDescription: Itsinda urutonde rw'ibicuruzwa rutondekanywamo. Kucamo ibice bigera ku rwego rumwe gusa.
categories.emptyBody: Icyiciro ntikigomba kubaho, ariko ni cyo gituma urutonde rurerure rusomeka.

warehouses.title: Ibigega
warehouses.description: Aho koperative ibika ibyo ifite. Ikigega ntikisibwa, gifungwa gusa.
warehouses.caption: Ibigega bya koperative, hamwe na kode, ahantu, ibyo buri kimwe kifite n'ikigega gisanzwe.
warehouses.loadFailed: Ntitwashoboye kubona ibigega. Reba uko interineti ihagaze hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
warehouses.showClosedHint: Ikigega cyafunzwe ntikwakira ububiko bushya, kandi kiguma n'ibikorwa byose byamaze kwandikwa kuri cyo.
warehouses.closeConsequence: Ikigega ntikwakira ububiko bushya, kandi ibikorwa byose byamaze kwandikwa kuri cyo biguma uko biri. Kishobora kongera gufungurwa igihe icyo ari cyo.
warehouses.closeHoldsStock: Iki kigega kifite ibicuruzwa {{total}}. Ikigega kifite ububiko ntigishobora kufungwa: banza wimure ibirimo ujye mu kindi kigega, hanyuma ugifunge.
warehouses.reopenConsequence: Ikigega kongera kwakira ububiko bushya, kandi gishobora guhitwamo igihe ububiko bwakirwa cyangwa bwimurwa.
warehouses.defaultMoved: {{name}} ubu ni ikigega gisanzwe. Ububiko bugera hano keretse hahiswemo ikindi kigega.
warehouses.emptyBody: Ububiko bugomba kugera ahantu. Ongeramo ikigega cya mbere cya koperative kandi kibe igisanzwe.

warehouseDialog.addDescription: Ahantu koperative ibika ububiko. Kishobora kuba ikigega, ahakusanyirizwa cyangwa icyumba ku biro.
warehouseDialog.editDescription: Izina, kode n'ahantu bihora bishobora guhinduka.
warehouseDialog.firstIsDefault: Iki ni ikigega cya mbere cya koperative, bityo kiba igisanzwe uko byaba byahiswemo hasi. Ububiko bugomba kugera ahantu.
warehouseDialog.firstIsDefaultShort: Ikigega cya mbere gihora ari igisanzwe.
warehouseDialog.alreadyDefault: Iki kimaze kuba ikigega gisanzwe. Koperative ihora ifite kimwe gusa, bityo shyira ikindi kigega nk'igisanzwe aho kukikuraho iki.

units.title: Ibipimo
units.description: Ibyo koperative ipimiramo. Nta kintu hano gitekereza ko ari kilo.
units.caption: Ibipimo, hamwe n'ikimenyetso, amazina yombi, imyanya nyuma ya akadomo n'umubare w'ibicuruzwa bikoresha buri kimwe.
units.loadFailed: Ntitwashoboye kubona ibipimo. Reba uko interineti ihagaze hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
units.showInactiveHint: Igipimo cyahagaritswe ntikitangwa ku bicuruzwa bishya, kandi kiguma n'ibicuruzwa byose byamaze kupimwa muri cyo.
units.sharedNoEdit: Gisangiwe na koperative zose, bityo izina ryacyo ntirihindurwa hano
units.emptyBody: Igicuruzwa ntikishobora kongerwamo mbere y'uko haba igipimo kipimwamo.

unitDialog.addDescription: Igipimo iyi koperative ipimiramo. Imifuka, litiro, imitwe n'iminsi y'ubukode byose ni ibipimo.
unitDialog.editDescription: Amazina n'ikimenyetso bishobora guhinduka. Urufunguzo n'imyanya nyuma ya akadomo ntibihinduka.
unitDialog.keyFixed: Urufunguzo ntiruhinduka: impapuro na raporo zisanzwe zirwerekeza.
unitDialog.precisionFixed: Imyanya nyuma ya akadomo ntihinduka: ingano zose zamaze kwandikwa muri iki gipimo zaziganyijwe kuri yo.

unitFields.keyHint: Inyuguti nkuru, imibare n'udusembuye, urugero SACK_50KG. Ni uko igipimo cyerekezwa mu raporo.
unitFields.symbolHint: Impine igaragara iruhande rwa buri ngano, urugero kg.
unitFields.precisionHint: Uko iki gipimo gipimwa neza. Umufuka ubarwa wose; uburemere ntibubarwa gutyo.
unitFields.factorHint: Urugero, toni imwe ni 1000 bya kilo.
